sloka: एवमुक्ते तदा राम ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा ।दशग्रीव उवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिरथाग्रतः ।। ७.१०.१८ ॥
transliteration: evamukte tadā rāma brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā ।daśagrīva uvācedaṁ kṛtāñjalirathāgrataḥ ।। 7.10.18 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, when Brahma, the creator of the worlds, spoke thus, Dashagriva then, with folded hands before him, said the following.
